❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Are all tools on ToolsWaala 100% free?

Yes, every tool on ToolsWaala is 100% free with zero hidden charges, zero subscription requirements, and zero signups required.

Is my file and personal data private?

Yes! All PDF processing, image compression, and financial calculations run 100% locally inside your browser memory. Files are never uploaded to any server.

Which university CGPA formulas are supported?

We support official SGPA/CGPA percentage formulas for 16+ universities including Mumbai University, VTU, AKTU, Anna University, KTU, SPPU, DU, CBSE, JNTUH, GTU, and SRM.

Can I generate GST invoices without creating an account?

Yes! Enter your business details, add line items with HSN codes, and download instant PDF invoices with 0% gateway fees or commissions.
